knownGaps: Production notification generation/seed data and live database integration were not exercised; the Mongoose adapter and empty-state behavior remain deterministic and safe.

The current runtime does not inject an RBAC permission resolver into the notification runtime. Notifications carrying a required permission fail closed until that adapter is provided; unqualified verified-admin notifications remain available.
